title: BIBO stability in infinite dimensions: extensions and limitations of finite-dimensional theory
summary: The study of bounded-input bounded-output (BIBO) stability of infinite-dimensional systems gives rise to difficulties that do not occur in the classical finite-dimensional setting. In this paper, we resolve several questions concerning the definition and characterisation of BIBO stability in the framework of system nodes. In particular, we show that $\mathrm C^\infty$-BIBO stability need not imply $L^\infty$-BIBO stability in general, but that the two notions are equivalent when the output space is reflexive.
